info.name: Integration Sync — GitHub & Taiga
info.description:
POST /v1/integrations/:id/sync — trigger a GitHub or Taiga sync. The provider is determined by the integration document stored in MongoDB (field `provider`), not by the URL.

Set collection variables first:
- baseUrl = http://localhost:3000
- githubIntegrationId = an integration with provider "github"
- taigaIntegrationId = an integration with provider "taiga"

Full walkthrough lives in docs/integration-sync-postman.md.

request.description:
Runs a GitHub sync for the integration named by `githubIntegrationId`. Prerequisites on the integration doc: provider="github", a PAT with `repo` scope stored as `token`, repository_name="owner/repo", is_deleted=false.

Fetches:
- GET https://api.github.com/repos/{owner}/{repo}/commits?per_page=100
- GET https://api.github.com/repos/{owner}/{repo}/pulls?state=all&per_page=100&sort=created&direction=desc
- GET https://api.github.com/repos/{owner}/{repo}/commits/{sha} (per-commit stats, first 50)

Expected 200:
{ "status": true, "status_message": "Sync complete.", "data_sets": { "status": "success", "items_synced": { "commits": 100, "pull_requests": 25, "total": 125 } } }
